{{Top|leg}}
'''Stresscrete''' was an inexpensive, [[Color/Legends|dark gray]] building material. When used properly, it formed durable hard floors and walls. If improperly mixed or set, it could crack and crumble over time. It was less expensive than ceramic [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] and was typically used for structures that needed to be built quickly and used only temporarily.
